messages:
anya: Quick UX review request — looking at Project Settings > Data residency & encryption. Two things: (1) the region picker focus order is weird when tabbing from the retention selector, and (2) the encryption label feels ambiguous to non-security folks. Can we do a 10-min sync?

mike: Yep, saw that. Repro steps? I hit Tab from ‘Retention period’ and the region list collapsed instead of focusing the first option.

olivia: repro: open project settings, tab to Retention, use shift+tab back and forth a couple times. On Chrome + VoiceOver the region list collapses because the trigger gets keyboard focus but not the listbox aria-activedescendant.

sam: also noticed the label reads: "Encryption: Managed key — Redwood" which folks read as we hold the key. Maybe change to something more explicit.

olivia: Suggested copy variants I mocked:```
- "Encryption: Managed by Redwood (we hold the key)"
- "Encryption: Customer-managed (BYOK) — you control the key"
- "Key ownership: Redwood-managed / Customer-managed"
```

anya: I like the third one for compactness, but worry about scanability. Also need an inline help icon that opens a short tooltip + link to docs. Tooltip must be accessible.

mike: For the regionpicker a11y fix: set role="listbox" on the expanded options and ensure aria-expanded on the trigger. Also move the DOM order so options follow the trigger (easier for screen readers). I'll prototype.

olivia: For keyboard flow we should avoid collapsing the list on blur if focus goes into the list. Essentially only close on Escape or click outside. Right now blur closes it immediately.

sam: On copy: ops asked for a one-line audit-friendly phrase that we can also ingest into support templates. Proposal: "Key ownership — Redwood-managed / Customer-managed (BYOK)" and underneath smaller text: "Who controls the encryption key for stored data."

anya: Nice. QA: can we also add a data-attribute for telemetry so support can see which option is set without exposing key details? e.g., data-key-owner="redwood|customer" on the settings row. @qa-bot any concerns?

qa-bot: No security issues flagged for a telemetry flag that indicates ownership as redwood|customer. Ensure the flag is not logged with KMS identifiers or key material. Recommend retention of that flag for 90 days only.

olivia: UI nit: the hover state on the managed key pill has contrast ~3.8:1 against background. Need >=4.5:1 for small text. Suggest we increase weight or change bg to darker blue.

mike: I'll upload a tiny patch: reorder DOM, add role/listbox, prevent blur-close when focus moves into list, and adjust pill styles. Will include the new copy as suggested.

anya: Amazing. Follow-ups: mike add a screenshot before/after to the PR, olivia add VoiceOver notes in the component README, sam add the short support blurb to the support playbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:
